config.protocol: A14 static split-half fixed ROI development comparison v1

roi_policy: Fixed spatial grid filtered by reference validity and original input masks for all predefined windows/parities, then ranked by reference gradient. No model outputs are inspected. ROIs and masks are frozen before comparing checkpoints.
scope: Native static ROI diagnostics; training-domain reevaluation is not unseen-scene or unseen-sensor generalization. Opposite parity prevents direct target averaging of evaluated input frames, but masks, reference selection and brightness estimation may still depend on the full sequence.

sources.name: mis20s1_1000x

region_policy.selector: reference-only Sobel magnitude; signal > mean black + 15 DN

raw.identity_note: Complete RAW was not rehashed. Existing source identity is recorded; exact selected raw, normalized input, target, and mask bytes are hashed per cached case.

sources.brightness_limitation: Existing opposite-parity means were exposure-normalized during construction. Inputs and predictions remain native DN, without per-case brightness fitting. Small drift and reference-estimation dependence remain; this is a development gain holdout, not independent clean GT.
